detail.longDescription: Thirty years later, fans are still finding little things to fix in Heroes of Might and Magic II My latest teeny tiny # NeoCities # RetroGaming feature looks at # fheroes2 , the # OpenSource project restoring missing artwork, improving battles and bringing this PC classic to handhelds, and the people keeping it alive :) https:// handheldhideout.neocities.org/ articles/the-fans-still-finding-things-to-fix-in-heroes-of-might-and-magic-ii
